description: This source file defines classes and a runner for load testing scenarios in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes parameter classes, a generic scenario runner class, and methods to configure and run load generators with cluster connection setup, metrics registration, and execution control.

classes.name: ClientParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for connecting to the Orleans cluster and Azure storage endpoints.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorParameters
classes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the load generator, such as number of workers, blocks, requests, and duration.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner
classes.description: A generic class responsible for setting up and executing a load testing scenario using Orleans client and a load generator.

methods.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scenario runner with a scenario and logger factory.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Asynchronous method that configures the Orleans client, registers metrics, warms up the generator, runs the load test, and then stops the host.
